abstract: From January 1995 to December 2000, medical records of 196 patients were collected from 14 hospitals nationwide and were reviewed retrospectively. We evaluated the clinicopathologic characteristics of malignant germ cell tumors in the ovaries of South Korean women and determined the prognostic factors affecting recurrence. The mean patient age was 23.8 years (range, 4-63 years), and the median follow-up period was 67 months (range, 1-128 months). The distribution of the International Federation of Gynecology and Obstetrics stage was as follows: 128 cases (65.3%) in stage I, 27 cases (13.8%) in stage II, 39 cases (19.9%) in stage III, and 2 cases (1.0%) in stage IV. Histologically, immature teratoma was the most common tumor type (n = 68), followed by dysgerminoma (n = 54), endodermal sinus tumor (n = 38), mixed form (n = 24), and choriocarcinoma (n = 12). A fertility-sparing operation was performed in 134 patients, staging operation in 43 patients, and hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy in 19 patients. Postoperative chemotherapy was administered in 166 patients, and the most common regimen was bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin (n = 120). Recurrence was observed in 13 patients (6.8%) and was influenced by the stage of the tumor and patient age (>40 years). The 5-year survival rate was 96.7%. During the follow-up period, 20 patients had 22 pregnancies that resulted in 17 normal deliveries at term and 5 abortions. The results of this study demonstrate that most malignant germ cell tumors of the ovary in Korean women are detected in the early stage and have excellent survival outcomes with conservative operation and platinum-based chemotherapy.
abstract_ja: 1995年1月から2000年12月までの196例の診療録を、全国14施設から収集し後方視的に検討した。卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍の臨床病理学的特徴と、再発に影響する予後因子を評価した。患者の平均年齢は23.8歳(範囲4～63歳)、追跡期間中央値は67か月(範囲1～128か月)であった。国際婦人科産科連合(FIGO)の病期分布は、病期Iが128例(65.3%)、病期IIが27例(13.8%)、病期IIIが39例(19.9%)、病期IVが2例(1.0%)であった。組織学的には、未熟奇形腫が最も多く(68例)、続いてディスジャーミノーマ(54例)、卵黄嚢腫瘍(38例)、混合型(24例)、絨毛癌(12例)であった。妊孕性温存手術は134例に、病期分類のための手術は43例に、子宮全摘術と両側卵管卵巣摘出術は19例に施行された。術後化学療法は166例に施行され、最も多いレジメンはブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン併用療法(120例)であった。再発は13例(6.8%)に認められ、腫瘍の病期と40歳超の年齢に影響されていた。5年生存率は96.7%であった。追跡期間中に20例が計22回の妊娠をし、そのうち17例は正期産による正常分娩、5例は流産であった。本研究の結果は、韓国人女性の卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍の大半は早期に発見され、保存的手術と白金製剤を用いた化学療法により良好な予後が得られることを示している。
